title: CODWOE - Comparing Dictionaries and Word Embeddings
description: Definition modeling for words in context, adapting SemEval-2022 Task 1 (CODWOE), which compared dictionary definitions with distributional word representations across two subtasks: definition modeling (embedding to definition) and reverse dictionary (definition to embedding). Based on Mickus et al.
